title: 產科
intro: 產前照護、分娩處置、剖腹產與產科急症。 本科程序庫由課程工序生成，並標示為模板生成。
introEn: Antenatal care, labour management, caesarean section and obstetric emergencies. This library is generated from the course steps and labelled as template-generated.

procedures.title: 剖腹產
procedures.patient: 依課程「剖腹產」設定的虛擬情境：Pfannenstiel 切口、子宮下段橫切、胎兒娩出與子宮縫合。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Caesarean section": Pfannenstiel incision, lower-segment transverse hysterotomy, delivery and uterine closure. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
